HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   C. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   C. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   D. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   D. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   D. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   C. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   C. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Global Governance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The 1st Generation of Industrial Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and conflict transformations in Kenya 4.2 Digital citizenship technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and Conflict transformations in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
